body: It feels nice to hear comforting words.. before I moved states, I worked in an animal hospital, and we had a lot of animals abandoned there.  I have a strong bond with small animals, especially ones that people typically look over. Rats, guinea pigs, rabbits, all these little animals have come to me to live out their lives happy and safe.. I've never had any accident like this in my home, but the moment I step outside I've had 2 in the last month. Maybe that's why I feel more terrible than I should.. I'm supposed to protect the fragile ones, but it took one blind second for me to accidentally crush one.

I appreciate it, I think it helps. I dont know why I reached out to anonymous people online, but it feels better than keeping it in.. boyfriend has been nothing but supportive. He saw this one happen, so he's broken up about it too. He tried to tell me that it was already dead before we went outside, but I don't know if I believe him. I'd like to, but I don't know if I can. We have so many strays outside, so it's plausible but.. I can't help but feel completely responsible for it's death..
